evidenceAudit.scope: Tinea corporis, cruris, pedis, manuum and onychomycosis in adults, children and pregnancy in India, including the current epidemic of extensive, steroid-modified and recurrent tinea, built on the ICMR Dermatophytoses STW (July 2022).
findings: KOH diagnosis, topical agents, nail lacquers and topical criteria, adult and paediatric systemic doses (terbinafine, griseofulvin, fluconazole, itraconazole), treatment until complete clearance with 2-weekly follow-up, pregnancy advice, avoidance of steroid-containing creams, referral criteria and general measures checked against the ICMR Dermatophytoses STW (July 2022).
unverifiedSections: The ICMR workflow lists systemic drugs without ranking; terbinafine is marked preferred as the first-listed agent.
The paediatric terbinafine fixed doses by weight band do not state frequency; once daily is assumed.
Liver test monitoring and drug-interaction cautions are general prescribing knowledge.
Drug cautions, contraindications and renal or hepatic adjustment lines without a source tag are general pharmacology statements and need formulary confirmation.

pathophysiology.summary: Dermatophytes (Trichophyton, Microsporum, Epidermophyton) infect keratin in the skin, hair and nails. India has seen a rise in extensive, chronic and recurrent tinea, driven by heat and humidity, tight synthetic clothing, shared towels, and misuse of over-the-counter steroid-antifungal combination creams that suppress inflammation while letting fungus spread. Steroid use changes the appearance: rings may be incomplete, scaling minimal and pigmentation prominent (ICMR STW). Limited disease is treated with topical azoles or terbinafine; extensive or nail disease needs oral therapy until complete clearance, often 3–8 weeks or longer.
keyMechanisms: Inflammation at the advancing edge produces the annular scaly ring.
Topical steroids suppress local immunity and allow spread (tinea incognito).
Moisture and occlusion in folds favour growth.

symptoms: Itchy, spreading rings in groin, buttocks, waist or trunk
physicalSigns: Annular plaques with scaly active edge and central clearing
Incomplete rings, minimal scale, pigmentation after steroid use (ICMR STW)
Toe-web maceration; moccasin scaling of soles
redFlags: No improvement after 4 weeks of regular treatment (ICMR STW)
Pregnancy, lactation, hepatic, renal or cardiac disease (ICMR STW)
precipitants: Heat, humidity, sweating, tight synthetic clothes

differentials.distinguishingFeatures: Silvery scale, extensor sites, nail pitting; KOH negative.
Coin-shaped oozing plaques without central clearing.
Groin or toe-web brown patches, coral-red fluorescence; KOH negative.

diagnosticCriteria.threshold: Annular scaly itchy plaques in typical sites.
Septate hyphae on KOH microscopy of scales in doubtful cases.
Under 50% of nail surface and not reaching the lunula, or oral drugs contraindicated.

clinicalManagement.title: Limited disease
actions: Topical azole or terbinafine cream twice daily (ICMR STW).
Continue until all lesions resolve; review every 2 weeks (ICMR STW).

clinicalManagement.title: Extensive disease
actions: Oral antifungal; creams on the most bothersome lesions (ICMR STW).
Treat until complete clearance; longer if palms, soles or after prolonged steroid use (ICMR STW).

clinicalManagement.title: Onychomycosis
actions: Limited nail disease: amorolfine or ciclopirox lacquer (ICMR STW).
Otherwise oral terbinafine (6 weeks fingernails, 12 weeks toenails) or itraconazole pulses (ICMR STW).

clinicalManagement.title: Stop steroid creams
actions: Stop all steroid-containing creams, including over-the-counter combinations (ICMR STW).

clinicalManagement.title: Refer
actions: Very extensive, no improvement at 4 weeks, recurrent, pregnancy, lactation, hepatic, renal or cardiac disease, or prolonged steroid use (ICMR STW).

medicationPlan.note: All doses are from the ICMR Dermatophytoses STW (July 2022). Avoid steroid-antifungal combination creams. India-only topic; the Saudi topic is unchanged. Not clinically reviewed.

learningObjectives: Confirm tinea with KOH when unsure.
Stop steroid creams and prevent recurrence.
keyPoints: Treat until complete clearance; review every 2 weeks.
Terbinafine 250 mg twice daily for extensive adult disease (ICMR).
pitfalls: Missing groin, buttock and nail lesions.
Ignoring re-infection from clothes and towels.

patientEducation: Complete the full course; do not stop when it looks better (ICMR STW).
Do not use steroid creams from the chemist (ICMR STW).
Nails take months to look normal.
lifestyleAndDiet: Bathe daily and dry well; loose cotton clothing.
Wash clothes separately in hot water and sun-dry inside out (ICMR STW).
Do not share towels or clothes (ICMR STW).
nonClinicalManagement.followUpPlan: Review every 2 weeks until all lesions clear (ICMR STW).
